query:
SELECT state, district, candidate1, candidate2, status, rating, primary_date FROM senate_races WHERE state IN ('Arkansas', 'Mississippi') ORDER BY state;
SELECT state, district, candidate1, candidate2, status, rating, primary_date FROM house_races WHERE state IN ('Arkansas', 'Mississippi') ORDER BY state, district;
